objective: Retain exact per-sample molecular splice-graph rows before a replicate-aware beta-binomial contrast.

design.contrast: explicit ordered A:B; effect is B minus A
design.counts_only: permits any condition count and emits no inferential test

candidate_graph.edge_recurrence: catalogue support >= min_support in >= min_edge_samples archives
candidate_graph.measurement: after selection, reduce all observed local evidence without imputing catalogue absence
candidate_graph.path: selected junction set co-supported by one archive UMI class on one strand

inference.response: one per-sample path count versus all same-strand path-fragment counts
inference.null: shared mean usage and shared beta-binomial concentration
inference.alternative: condition-specific mean usage and shared beta-binomial concentration
inference.effect: fitted condition B mean minus fitted condition A mean
inference.reserved_extension: joint Dirichlet-multinomial or hierarchical Dirichlet graph model

real_gate.dataset: GSE234790 / PRJNA983239 eight adult SEZ donors
real_gate.forbidden: constructing an arbitrary donor contrast or changing the registered FNBP1 STOP

acceptance: standalone and cohort exact counts agree
sample path and edge matrices contain explicit zeros
the sample is the only inferential unit
null and strong-shift synthetic controls order correctly
insufficient eligibility suppresses rather than fabricates a test
malformed input and overflow fail closed
